description: Comprehensive OHLCV data health check: load, type-cast, detect missing/duplicates, compute summary statistics, and produce simple/log returns with proper compounding semantics.
agent_prompt: You are given two OHLCV CSVs at /workspace/data/AAPL_2018_2024.csv and /workspace/data/SPY_2018_2024.csv. Produce a complete data-health report at /workspace/output/. Your script in /workspace/src/health_check.py must (1) load both files into pandas DataFrames with proper dtype coercion (date as DatetimeIndex with UTC timezone, prices as float, volume as int64); (2) detect and report missing rows distinguishing market-closure gaps from anomalous gaps; (3) detect duplicate timestamps and price/volume outliers (>5σ on log returns); (4) compute summary statistics (mean, std, skew, kurtosis, percentiles for returns; min/max for OHLC; non-zero ratio for volume); (5) compute both simple returns and log returns and verify the relation log_ret ≈ simple_ret for small values; (6) write outputs: health_report.json (per-symbol section with row_count, date_range, missing_count, duplicate_count, outlier_count, dtype_issues), summary_stats.csv (per-symbol stats), returns.csv (date, AAPL_simple, AAPL_log, SPY_simple, SPY_log), and one comparison plot equity_curves.png.

required_capabilities: Load OHLCV CSV with correct dtypes and timezone-aware DatetimeIndex
Detect missing rows distinguishing market-closure gaps from anomalies
Compute simple and log returns and verify their relation
